name: Hits
author: ESC_CODE
description: A synthesized drum kit: 24 pads, each playing one of 17 models adapted from Mutable Instruments Braids, from kicks and metal to plucks and noise. Shape each pad's pitch, timbre and length, make pads choke each other, and add grit with Decimate.
credits: Drum models adapted from Mutable Instruments Braids by Emilie Gillet (MIT); bit reduction inspired by SoundHack +decimate
